title: What is the One Piece Card Game?
goal: Learn what you're trying to do in a game, and what you need to play.

steps.html:
The One Piece Card Game is a battle between two pirate captains. You are one of them.

Your captain is a card called your Leader. You build a crew of Characters, attack your opponent's Leader, and protect your own.

How you win:

  • Every Leader starts with a few face-down Life cards. Each time you hit your opponent's Leader, they lose 1 Life.
  • When they have 0 Life and you hit their Leader one more time, you win.
  • You also win if your opponent's Deck runs out of cards.

What each player brings:

  • 1 Leader card.
  • A 50-card deck of Characters, Events and Stages.
  • 10 DON!! cards. DON!! are your energy. You spend them to play cards.
A game usually takes 20 to 30 minutes. Don't worry about memorizing anything yet. Every underlined word in Deckhand can be tapped to see what it means.

quiz.q: Your opponent has 0 Life cards left. What happens when you hit their Leader once more?
choices: Nothing, Leaders can't be hit at 0 Life
quiz.why: At 0 Life, the next hit on the Leader ends the game.

quiz.q: How many cards are in your main deck?
quiz.why: A deck is exactly 50 cards. Your Leader and your 10 DON!! are kept separate.

choices: They are your energy for playing cards
They are only used in tournaments
quiz.why: You spend DON!! to pay for cards, and you can attach them to cards to make them stronger.
